title: Screen↔PDF parity pin is payload-side only, but its docstring claims reverting either copy fails a test
evidence:
/// analyses (W1): the arrays live in BOTH `demo_store.analysis_for` and the
/// payloads, and reverting either copy to "[]" must fail a test.
detail: The test only reads pdf_prebake.payloads(); demo_store.analysis_for and demo_fixtures.gleam live in the client package and no test reads their flag/positive/statement arrays. Client-side edits drift silently — the exact hand-sync regression class (r1 B1) the header says this pins. Shipped state verified in sync today.
recommended_fix: Soften the docstring to payload-side coverage, or add a client-side test pinning demo_store.analysis_for flags/positives against the same canonical arrays.
